name: Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof
beschreibung: Berggasthof Hinterduxerhof is situated near Kufstein in Tyrol. Perched in an elevated position, the mountain inn offers sweeping views across the scenic Inn Valley. The rooms feature rustic alpine furnishings. The restaurant serves fine Tyrolean and Austrian cuisine. The inn is a popular base for hikers and skiers looking to explore the mountains. The surrounding landscape invites guests to engage in outdoor recreational activities. The property is lovingly operated as a family-run business.
